WAVE RIDERS

LED Brightness Control Using a Potentiometer

## 1\. Statement

To design a simple LED brightness control circuit using a 9V battery and potentiometer, where the potentiometer is used to vary the current through the LED and control its brightness.

## 2\. Materials Required

9V Battery  
LED  
Potentiometer  
Resistor  
Breadboard  
Jumper wires

## 3\. Procedure

1\. Connect the 9V battery to the breadboard power supply.  
2\. Connect the LED in series with a suitable resistor.  
3\. Connect the potentiometer in series with the LED circuit.  
4\. Check the LED polarity and wiring.  
5\. Turn the potentiometer slowly to vary the LED brightness.  
6\. Observe the change in brightness as the potentiometer is adjusted.

## 4\. Notes

The potentiometer controls the LED brightness by varying the resistance/current.  
Always use a current-limiting resistor with the LED..  
Check LED polarity before connecting the battery.  
Avoid short-circuiting the 9V battery.  
Use a suitable potentiometer rating for the circuit.
